scope: Whole-book 2 Chronicles recurring vocabulary concordance, not a full fresh continuous reading or independent review.
findings: Faithful love retained across 1:8, 5:13, 6:14, 6:42, 7:3, 7:6, 20:21; David-related ambiguity remains noted in prior chapter.
Seeking, humbling, abandoning and returning remain recognizable across royal episodes; literal travel returns share the English root appropriately.
Healing in 7:14 and 30:20 connects with no remedy in 36:16. Compassion in 36:15 and its absence in 36:17 now use the same word.
High-place removal and persistence notices remain distinct; no harmonization of 14:3/15:17 or 17:6/20:33.
Ahaziah forty-two and Jehoiachin eight remain source-based textual choices; no silent substitution from Kings.
Cyrus proclamation shares wording with Ezra 1 while retaining Ezra’s extended invitation and distinct divine wording.
remaining: Full continuous whole-book English and apparatus review remains queued. No earlier ledger rebind needed.
